entities.summary: Vladimir Davidovich Baranov-Rossiné, also spelled Baranoff-Rossiné, born Shulim Wolf Leib Baranov, was a painter and sculptor active in Russia and France. His work belonged to the avant-garde movement of Cubo-Futurism. He was also an inventor, author of several patents.
